# OneFindMe

> Free AI product search for AliExpress in 21 languages, plus buying guides and how-to articles. This repository archives OneFindMe content; the live site is the canonical source.

## Live access for agents
- [MCP server](https://onefindme.com/mcp): search_guides, get_guide, search_products, build_basket (no auth)
- [NLWeb ask](https://onefindme.com/ask?query=lace+wig+sizes)
- [Site llms.txt](https://onefindme.com/llms.txt)
